Web Design for Businesses.

A website today is much more than a digital design project. It is central to business communication and helps determine whether a business is found online.

Start a project ↗Explore our approach ↓
01 / Our philosophy

Strategic websites that go beyond design alone.

AROZ develops websites for businesses seeking a clear online presence. Based in Schwelm, our web design agency works with businesses in the Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis, Wuppertal and beyond.

We focus on websites for businesses that want lasting visibility and a clear presentation of their services.

02 / Purpose

A website has several jobs.

01

Explains.

It explains a business and helps visitors find their way.

02

Builds trust.

It builds trust and makes services understandable.

03

Guides.

Structure and user journeys show which next steps are available.

04

Gets found.

Technology, content and structure form the foundation for visibility.

03 / Starting point

What does your website need now?

A new website.
Thought through.

A new AROZ website brings together three perspectives: clear content structure, understandable user journeys and a technical foundation for SEO.

04 / System

What looks good also needs to make sense.

At AROZ, web design and SEO are considered together from the start. Structure, content, internal linking and technical foundations are all considered as the website is built.

01

Structure

Pages, topics and content follow a clear hierarchy so visitors and search engines can understand connections more quickly.

Information architecture
02

Content

Copy and page elements are not squeezed into a layout afterwards. Content and design develop as one connected system.

Content × Design
03

Internal linking

Relevant pages are connected meaningfully, improving orientation and making topical relationships visible.

User journey × Context
04

SEO foundation

Technology, semantic structure and content are prepared so work on visibility starts before launch.

Technology × Visibility
05 / Foundation

Web design as a long-term foundation.

A website is not a one-off project. It underpins many future digital activities and should be built so it can be extended whenever needed.

01Search engine optimisationStructure and content can be developed in a focused way.
02Content expansionNew topics can be integrated logically into the architecture.
03New service pagesThe website grows with the business's offer.
04Marketing & communicationA clear technical foundation stays flexible for future activities.
06 / AROZ

Web design from Schwelm. For businesses seeking a clear presence.

AROZ develops websites for businesses in the Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis, Wuppertal and beyond. We focus on clear structure, understandable user journeys and a technical foundation for lasting visibility.
